inputExample.text: I am so happy and excited today, but a little nervous too.

usage.outputShape: body.emotions (STUB: returns the literal string "emotions value", not real data), body.processedAt
quirks: Endpoint charges $0.01 and returns HTTP 200 but the body is a hardcoded placeholder: body.emotions is the literal string 'emotions value' — NOT real per-emotion intensities.
The server does not actually process the input text; the response is a fixed template regardless of body. Do not pay this endpoint — money is lost for no useful result.
usage.guide: Do not call this endpoint. It is a non-functional stub: although it accepts a POST {text} body, charges $0.01 USDC on Base, and returns HTTP 200, the response is always a hardcoded placeholder {"emotions":"emotions value","processedAt":<timestamp>} with no real emotion analysis. Use a different emotion/sentiment analysis provider.
